invariants.text: Customer.customer_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Product.product_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Order.order_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Order.customer_id must reference an existing Customer.customer_id
OrderProduct.order_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
OrderProduct.product_id must reference an existing Product.product_id
When an order is cancelled, the quantity of each product in that order must be added back to the product's stock_quantity.
The total quantity of a product across all orders must not exceed its stock_quantity unless the product is being reordered or restocked.
The sum of quantities of products in an order must equal the total order quantity, and this sum must be consistent across all order product records.
Product stock_quantity must always be non-negative after any update or cancellation operation.
An order can only be cancelled if it is in a status that allows cancellation, such as 'pending' or 'confirmed', and not 'completed' or 'cancelled'.
Product searches and filters must return only products that match the specified criteria, such as name, category, or price range.
All modifications to the database, including creating, updating, or cancelling orders and products, must be persisted atomically using a single transaction.
The order status must be updated to 'cancelled' when an order is successfully cancelled, and this status change must be reflected in the database immediately.
The sum of quantities of products in all active orders must not exceed the total available stock of those products.
Product stock_quantity must be updated only when a product is added to an order or when an order is cancelled.
